title: System Architecture — C4 Container Diagram
purpose: Full system context: frontend (React), backend (Express), PostgreSQL (Supabase), Socket.IO, and all 8 external integrations (Supabase Auth, Stripe, R2, OpenAI/OpenRouter, Ethereum RPC, BaseScan, Nodemailer, Netlify/Render).
description: C4 context diagram showing the PoDM platform's high-level containers — React SPA (Vite 7, Tailwind CSS), Express API (Express 5, TypeScript), PostgreSQL database (Supabase), and Socket.IO server — connected to external systems: Stripe (payments), Cloudflare R2 (file storage), Supabase Auth (JWT auth), OpenAI/OpenRouter (AI captions), PoDMPaymentProtocol smart contract on Base/Monad/MegaETH, SMTP via Nodemailer, and Ethereum RPC/BaseScan for on-chain verification. Three human actors interact: Fan (subscribes, views, tips), Creator (publishes, manages, earns), Admin (moderates, manages, views analytics).

actors.label: Fan
actors.description: Subscribes to creators, views content, sends tips. Interacts exclusively through the React SPA via HTTPS.

actors.label: Creator
actors.description: Publishes content, manages subscriptions, earns revenue. Interacts through the React SPA. Uses MetaMask/Web3 wallet for crypto transactions.

actors.label: Admin
actors.description: Moderates content, manages users, views analytics. Interacts through the React SPA.

systems.label: PoDM Platform
systems.description: The entire bounded system containing the React SPA, Express API, PostgreSQL database, and Socket.IO server.

modules.label: React SPA
modules.description: Single-page application for fans, creators, and admins. Built with React 18, Vite 7, Tailwind CSS. Handles routing, state management, and UI rendering.

modules.label: Express API
modules.description: REST API handling all business logic. Built with Express 5, TypeScript, Node.js on Render. All data operations flow through this layer.

modules.label: PostgreSQL Database
modules.description: Supabase PostgreSQL instance storing users, content, transactions, subscriptions, messages, analytics, and platform settings. Accessed via supabase-js client.

modules.label: Socket.IO Server
modules.description: WebSocket server colocated with Express on port 5000. Provides real-time bidirectional messaging for conversation rooms, typing indicators, and broadcast events.

services.label: apiClient.ts
services.description: Axios-based HTTP client with request/response interceptors for auth token injection, impersonation header attachment, and 401 auto-logout handling.

services.label: Auth Middleware (auth.middleware.ts)
services.description: Express middleware that validates JWT via supabase.auth.getUser(), fetches user profile, applies role guards, and handles impersonation header swapping.

externalSystems.label: Stripe
externalSystems.description: Payment processing for subscriptions, SetupIntents, and payment method management. Frontend uses Stripe Elements for card UI. Backend Stripe endpoints are partially dead (tipping/PPV endpoints 404).

externalSystems.label: Cloudflare R2
externalSystems.description: S3-compatible object storage for content files (images, video, audio), thumbnails, watermarked images, avatars, banners, and verification documents. Two buckets: podm-private (signed URL access) and podm-public.

externalSystems.label: Supabase Auth
externalSystems.description: JWT authentication and user management service. Handles password hashing, token generation, email/password sign-in, and password reset emails. Server-side client configured with autoRefreshToken: false, persistSession: false.

externalSystems.label: OpenAI / OpenRouter
externalSystems.description: AI caption generation for uploaded images/videos. OpenRouter used when API key starts with 'sk-or-v1' (model: google/gemma-3-27b-it:free), otherwise default OpenAI endpoint. Returns caption in ~1-5 seconds.

externalSystems.label: Smart Contract (PoDMPaymentProtocol)
externalSystems.description: Solidity contract deployed on Base (mainnet/sepolia), Monad, and MegaETH. Implements paySubscription, payTip, payPPV functions. Emits events parsed by backend for transaction verification.

externalSystems.label: SMTP (Nodemailer)
externalSystems.description: Transactional email service configured with SMTP_HOST/PORT/USER/PASS env vars. Currently wired but has zero callers—no email notifications are sent in production.

externalSystems.label: Ethereum RPC / BaseScan
externalSystems.description: On-chain transaction verification via JSON-RPC calls to eth_getTransactionReceipt. Network selection by creator's payout preference (base, monad, megaeth). Verifies receipt status, contract address match, topics[2] recipient parse, and data field amount comparison.

externalSystems.label: Netlify / Render
externalSystems.description: Hosting providers: Netlify serves the frontend SPA (podm.app), Render hosts the backend Express API (podm.onrender.com). Cloudflare Pages provides PR preview deployments.

dataStores.label: Supabase PostgreSQL
dataStores.description: Primary database storing 12+ tables: profiles, content, subscriptions, transactions, messages, conversations, galleries, analytics_events, monthly_analytics_summary, platform_settings, support_tickets, reports, contests, contest_entries, referral_codes, referral_redemptions, enclave_applications. Also holds 12 enum types.

dataStores.label: Cloudflare R2 Private Bucket
dataStores.description: Stores all uploaded content files (originals, thumbnails, watermarked temps). Access restricted to signed URLs with configurable expiry (3600s for thumbnails, 60s for view URLs).

dataStores.label: Cloudflare R2 Public Bucket
dataStores.description: Stores publicly accessible assets: user avatars, creator banners. No signed URL required.

entryPoints.label: HTTPS Ingress
entryPoints.description: All external traffic arrives via HTTPS on port 443. Frontend served by Netlify, backend by Render. DNS routes podm.app to Netlify and podm.onrender.com to Render.

entryPoints.label: WebSocket Connection (Socket.IO)
entryPoints.description: Client establishes Socket.IO connection to the Express server on port 5000. JWT authentication validated during handshake. Room-based messaging for conversations.

exitPoints.label: JSON API Response
exitPoints.description: All API endpoints return JSON with standardized format: { success: boolean, data?: any, message?: string }. Errors return { success: false, error: { message, statusCode } }.

exitPoints.label: S3 Upload Stream
exitPoints.description: Content files uploaded to Cloudflare R2 via AWS S3 SDK PutObjectCommand. 3 retries with exponential backoff (500ms, 1000ms, 2000ms) on failure.

preconditions: All external services (Supabase, Stripe, R2, RPC endpoints) are reachable and configured with valid API keys
Smart contract is deployed on at least one supported chain (Base, Monad, MegaETH)
PostgreSQL database has all required tables and enums created via migrations
Frontend is built and deployed to Netlify (production) or running via Vite dev server (local)
postconditions: Authenticated users receive JWT tokens stored in localStorage/sessionStorage
Content files are durably stored in R2 with database records referencing their paths
Transactions are recorded in PostgreSQL with on-chain verification where applicable
Real-time messages are delivered via Socket.IO rooms and persisted to database

nodes.label: Fan
nodes.description: Human user who browses, subscribes, views content, sends tips, and participates in contests. Unauthenticated users have limited access (public profiles, login/signup).

nodes.label: Creator
nodes.description: Human user who publishes content, manages subscription tiers, views analytics, requests payouts. Requires creator role assigned at signup.

nodes.label: Admin
nodes.description: Human user who moderates content, manages users, views platform analytics, accesses verification documents, impersonates users. Requires admin role.

nodes.label: React SPA (Vite 7, Tailwind)
nodes.description: Frontend application serving fans, creators, and admins. Uses React Router for client-side routing, AuthProvider for auth state, and apiClient for API calls. Stripe Elements for payment UI. MetaMask/Web3 for wallet transactions.

nodes.label: Express API (Express 5, TypeScript)
nodes.description: REST API on port 5000. Handles CORS, JSON body parsing (1100MB limit), multer file uploads, auth middleware validation, controller routing, service business logic, and model database access.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL (Supabase)
nodes.description: Primary data store with 12+ tables, 12 enums. Accessed via supabase-js client through model layer. Handles all persistent data: user profiles, content, subscriptions, transactions, messages, analytics.

nodes.label: Socket.IO Server
nodes.description: WebSocket server colocated with Express. Handles authenticated connections, room management (conversation rooms), event emission (new_message, message_deleted, conversation_read).

nodes.label: Stripe
nodes.description: External payment processor. Receives SetupIntents for payment method setup. Frontend integrates via Stripe Elements. Tipping/PPV/Subscription payment endpoints on backend are partially dead.

nodes.label: Cloudflare R2
nodes.description: S3-compatible object storage. Stores original content, thumbnails, watermarked images, avatars, banners, verification docs. Private bucket requires signed URLs for access.

nodes.label: Supabase Auth
nodes.description: External JWT auth service. Validates tokens via supabase.auth.getUser(). Handles signup, login, password reset emails. Service role key used for admin operations (deleteUser, updateUserById).

nodes.label: OpenAI / OpenRouter
nodes.description: AI caption generation service. API key routing: sk-or-v1 prefix → OpenRouter, otherwise → OpenAI. Model: gemma-3-27b-it:free. Returns single witty caption with emojis and hashtags.

nodes.label: PoDMPaymentProtocol (Smart Contract)
nodes.description: Solidity contract on Base/Monad/MegaETH. Functions: paySubscription, payTip, payPPV. Emits PaymentSent events containing sender, recipient, amount, contentId. Backend parses event topics for verification.

nodes.label: SMTP (Nodemailer)
nodes.description: Email sending service using nodemailer. Configured with SMTP env vars. Currently wired but zero callers—transactional emails are not sent.

nodes.label: Ethereum RPC / BaseScan
nodes.description: On-chain verification via JSON-RPC. Endpoints: mainnet.base.org, sepolia.base.org, monad-mainnet.g.allthatnode.com, mainnet.megaeth.systems. Verifies receipt status, contract match, recipient, and amount.

nodes.label: Vite Dev Proxy
nodes.description: Development-only proxy that routes /api/* requests from frontend dev server (localhost:5173) to backend (localhost:5000). Configured in vite.config.ts.

validationRules: File uploads enforce size limit (1GB per file, 10 files max via multer)
JWT tokens validated on every authenticated request via supabase.auth.getUser()
Content access gated by subscription status, tier level, and PPV purchase
CORS policy restricts origins to podm.app, *.pages.dev, localhost:5173
businessRules: Enclave members receive reduced 10% platform fee (not yet implemented)
Subscription has no renewal logic—static after creation
securityConsiderations: JWT_SECRET and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY exposed in frontend .env
Sandbox bypass: transactions with hash starting 0x0000 skip all on-chain verification
No token revocation or blacklist mechanism exists
Auth debug log writes PII (user IDs, emails) to server/debug.log
No rate limiting on login/signup routes
Watermarking failure degrades security—original unwatermarked image served
performanceConsiderations: Every authenticated request triggers 2 Supabase API calls (JWT verify + user lookup)
No caching layer (Redis/memcached) for any data
Mass message iterates subscriber list synchronously (N+1 pattern)
Creator dashboard aggregates 5+ parallel queries per page load
Admin dashboard runs 5 parallel queries with no caching
AI caption generation adds 1-5 seconds synchronous HTTP wait
Signed URLs regenerated per request—no caching

annotations.text: Stripe tipping/PPV endpoints are dead—frontend calls to /payments/tip and /payments/unlock-post return 404
Nodemailer is wired but has zero callers—no transactional emails sent
No queue/broker—all workflows execute synchronously or as unawaited promises
Watermarked temp files accumulate in R2 temp/ path—no garbage collection

legend.meaning: Human role interacting with the system
Application container (React SPA, Express API, Socket.IO)
